integrity: Analytical proof includes explicit quantifiers and a dominated two-singularity scaling argument. Numerical tests are supplementary, not infinite verification. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strict inequality and two-pulse first-variation only; no formula for unrestricted optimal q-ACB constant; does not cover alpha*p>=1 or non-power weights. The source date is the arXiv v1 first-public date.
